responsibility: This target configuration header supplies the RTEMS-specific AArch64 OS layer. It declares init-section support and overrides TARGET_OS_CPP_BUILTINS to predefine RTEMS environment macros such as __rtems__ and __USE_INIT_FINI__ and the corresponding system assertion, thereby connecting the generic AArch64 backend to RTEMS preprocessing and runtime-startup conventions rather than instruction selection or scheduling behavior.
